shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files && printf '\\n--- command/date/format references ---\\n' && rg -n \"format_duration|struct .*Entry|TimeEntry|since|until|Date|Project|No Project|enum Command|Entry\" src Cargo.toml"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/commands/mod.rs && sed -n '1,120p' src/api/client.rs && sed -n '280,370p' src/models.rs && sed -n '1,120p' src/models.rs"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '390,560p' src/models.rs; rg -n \"normalize_time_entry_list_filters|format_duration_hms|duration\" src/utilities.rs src/commands/*_test.rs src/commands 2>/dev/null | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- src/utilities.rs src/commands/stats.rs src/commands/mod.rs src/arguments.rs src/main.rs && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/commands/stats.rs | sed -n '1,130p'; nl -ba src/utilities.rs | sed -n '10,38p'; nl -ba src/arguments.rs | sed -n '155,195p'; nl -ba src/main.rs | sed -n '248,265p'"

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "StatsCommand::execute|EntryAction::Stats|format_duration_compact|Standing conventions" src AGENTS.md && cargo fmt && cargo test --lib && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings'
/bin/bash -lc 'cargo fmt && cargo test commands::stats && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && git diff --stat && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- AGENTS.md src/commands/stats.rs src/arguments.rs src/main.rs'
